selection_rule: Two outcome-selected Predict Position test illustrations in which NanoJev succeeds and both Jev and Untuned Qwen fail: an extended wait before the shot, and a turn before firing. Full test and OOD scores each include all 128 frozen cases and are reported separately from these selected wins.

cases.title: Wait for the window
cases.description: NanoJev waits while the target moves, then lands its one shot. Jev and Untuned Qwen fire earlier and miss.

cases.title: Turn into the shot
cases.description: NanoJev turns before firing and hits the moving target. Both comparison policies miss this seed.
